name: roomlink
description: RoomLink: lightweight rooms for people, chat, and peer-to-peer files

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @roomlink/shared && npm run build --workspace @roomlink/server && npm run build --workspace @roomlink/web
scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @roomlink/server & npm run dev --workspace @roomlink/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @roomlink/shared && npm run test --workspace @roomlink/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @roomlink/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @roomlink/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @roomlink/web
